verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Warp publishes an llms.txt at docs.warp.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), describing its docs for the agentic development environment. Its docs are also split into agent-oriented sections (_llms-txt/agents.txt, warp-agent-cli.txt, automation-platform.txt, code.txt, and others) plus an llms-small.txt variant, so an agent can be pointed at focused, machine-friendly docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on pointing agents at these files, and independent or community corroboration of agents using them in practice.
